title: Export Version Fingerprint v1
description: Structural schema for ExportVersionFingerprint — addresses the Sprint 6 gap (ALCHEMIST-GAP: missing version fingerprints) specifically for exported artifacts. See docs/bible/09-foundry/208-export-version-fingerprint.md for the exact CURRENT/PARTIAL/PLANNED status of each field, verified by inspection during Sprint 7.

foundryVersion.description: PLANNED — no distinct Foundry version constant exists.

cadQueryVersion.description: PARTIAL — installable, but never recorded on any generated artifact; see backend/requirements.txt's cadquery>=2.5 minimum pin.

openCascadeVersion.description: PARTIAL — JewelMind never queries or records this as structured metadata, but it is empirically present inside every exported STEP file's own header (confirmed during Sprint 7: 'Open CASCADE 7.9' / 'Open CASCADE STEP processor 7.9'), just not extracted or surfaced by any JewelMind code.

meshToleranceMm.description: CURRENT for STL only — the actual tolerance used for this specific export.
